6.237 rsInvalidTablixCornerRowSpans
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidTablixCornerRowSpans is a critical error that will occur when the combined value of all
CellContents.RowSpan elements aligned with a particular TablixColumn element does not equal the
number of TablixMember elements within the TablixColumnHierarchy that contain a
TablixMember.TablixHeader child element.
